game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing, a rope bridge over a pit: the spelunker must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Dam Filler: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing: a rope bridge over a pit
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 8: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for B and Unix.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: level drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
